reasons.claim: The suspended chain names Ata' then Ibn Abbas, whose account of the marriages is the report.
The report only points to another report's wording and names no transmitter.
Hammad asks the Imam, who answers, so Hammad then the Imam close the chain (rulings 2 and 3).
reasons.quote: عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The father of al-Barqi is a relation link between him and Ibn Abi Umayr.
reasons.quote: قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِی عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِی عُمَیْرٍ

reasons.claim: Qatada asks Anas and Anas answers, so Anas is the last link after Qatada.
reasons.quote: عن قتادة، قال سألت أنس بن مالك

reasons.claim: After Sulayman the route is not written, a gap read as one unnamed link; the man asking the Prophet is in the story.
reasons.quote: عن أخيه سليمان بن داود باسناده رفعه

reasons.claim: Muhammad ibn Muslim heard the Imam speak, so the Imam is the last link.

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes to a source with no saying (unruled); the structure is right if it is stored as a route, and there is no route if the owner rules such statements are not chains.

reasons.claim: The opening names the source whose route is stated, not a link of the chain.
reasons.quote: و ما كان فيه عن أبي أيّوب الخزّاز فقد رويته

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Abu Ayyub, and the remark on his name adds no transmitter.
reasons.quote: عن أبي أيّوب إبراهيم بن عثمان الخزّاز، و يقال إنّه إبراهيم ابن عيسى

reviews.uncertainty_note: The whole item depends on the unruled route-statement question.

reasons.claim: The chain runs through an unnamed hearer to Hanan, who tells the story.
reasons.quote: حدثني من سمع حنان بن سدير الصيرفي يقول

reasons.claim: In the narrated encounter al-Sadiq speaks, so under ruling 9 he is the last link of his saying.
The Imam is named inside the story, after the chain.
reasons.quote: دخلت على الصادق جعفر بن محمد

reasons.claim: The Prophet's words in the dream end at Hanan, because the Prophet is never a link; that makes two sayings (ruling 10).

groups.saying_opens: رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله

levels.surface: أبو جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن موسى بن بابويه القمي
أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

groups.saying_opens: فلما كان من الغد دخلت على الصادق

levels.surface: أبو جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن موسى بن بابويه القمي
أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: Ruling 9: al-Sadiq speaks in the narrated encounter and is the last link of his saying; the Prophet's words in the dream end at Hanan.

reviews.uncertainty_note: Whether the dream is a separate saying, or one story ending at al-Sadiq, is open to a second reading.

reasons.claim: The dual verb makes the two Ahmads co-transmitters of one level.
reasons.quote: قالا حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب

reasons.claim: Sa'id and Abu Salama are co-transmitters from Abu Hurayra, which gives four routes.
reasons.quote: عن سعيد بن المسيب، وأبي، سلمة بن عبد الرحمن

reasons.claim: The passive verb names no transmitter, so the report has no isnad.
